edition.description: The edition, as the standard names it. SFRS for Small Entities' Third Edition applies to financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2027.

framework.description: sfrs_se is SFRS for Small Entities, the recommended one (open question 31); frs is FRS; sfrs_i is SFRS(I).

from_on.description: The first day of the financial year it applies from, until a later version replaces it; at most a year after the current one.
